preboarding.label: Preboarding
preboarding.description: The task lists a preboarding starts with. Preboarding is for somebody who has not logged in yet, and happens on one page behind a link.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.description: The task lists an onboarding starts with. Onboarding happens inside the app, once the new person has logged in.

offboarding.label: Offboarding
offboarding.description: The task lists an offboarding starts with, counted from the last working day — handing over work, returning equipment, the exit interview.

pause.OWNER_LEFT: {name} left the company, so it can't run.
pause.OWNER_LACKS_RIGHT: {name} can't manage automations any more, so it can't run.
pause.TARGET_GONE: A step points to something that's gone, so it can't run.

reason.FORWARD_ONLY: It wasn't run: it was turned on for new cases only, and this one had passed.
reason.LATE_DATA: It ran late: the date it counts from was entered after the day had passed.
reason.MOMENT_PASSED: It wasn't run: its day had already passed.
reason.NO_LONGER_MATCHES: It was skipped: the person no longer matches who it runs for.
reason.ANCHOR_CLEARED: It was cancelled: the date it counted from was cleared.
reason.RULE_TURNED_OFF: It was cancelled: the automation was turned off.
reason.RULE_ARCHIVED: It was cancelled: the automation was archived.
reason.RULE_PAUSED: It was cancelled: the automation was paused.
reason.PERSON_LEFT: It was cancelled: the person left.
reason.TERMINATION_CANCELLED: It was cancelled: the termination was cancelled.
reason.NO_RECIPIENT: It was skipped: there was nobody to send it to.
reason.NO_ONBOARDING_MANAGER: It was skipped: the person has no onboarding manager.
reason.NO_ASSIGNEE: We couldn't create the task: there is nobody to give it to.
reason.NO_TARGET: It was skipped: this person has no such calendar.
reason.NOT_ASSIGNED: It was skipped: this automation had not given it, so it can't take it back.
reason.HAND_OVERRIDE: It was skipped: it was set by hand to something else.
reason.RULE_CONFLICT: It was skipped: another automation sets this.
reason.DUPLICATE: It was skipped: they already have it.
reason.OUTRANKED: It was skipped: a more specific place gives this person their holiday calendar.
reason.MISSING_PLACEHOLDER: It failed: a field it uses has no value for this person.
reason.STRUCTURAL: It failed: something it uses is gone.
reason.CONDITION_NOT_MET: It was skipped: its “Only if” didn't hold for this person.
reason.OBJECT_CLOSED: It was cancelled: the time off it counted from was cancelled or declined.
reason.MISSED: It didn't run on its day; only the latest one ran.
reason.TIMED_OUT: It waited as long as it may.
reason.NO_APPROVER: It failed: there is nobody to approve it.
reason.AUTHOR_LEFT: It failed: its owner left, so the automation is paused.
reason.AUTHOR_LACKS_RIGHT: It failed: its owner can no longer do this, so the automation is paused.
reason.NOT_THIS_PATH: It was skipped: the run took another path.
reason.NOT_REACHED: It was skipped: the step before it didn't run.
reason.SKIPPED_FOR_NOW: It was skipped: it is set to “Skip for now”.
reason.NO_DATE: It was skipped: the person has no date to count it from.
reason.NOT_CONNECTED: This step isn't connected yet, so it was skipped.
